title: Bound for a restricted Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, and let $P$ be a subset of an $n$-element set. Write $d$ for the number of elements outside $P$, and set $r=\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor$. The number of subsets of a $d$-element set having size at most $r$ is at most $(r+1)(n+1)^r$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a subset of an $n$-element set
